quotes.candidate: the Blessed One taught the following to show the faults of abiding: Furthermore, when a bodhisattva mahasattva practices
quotes.reference: Furthermore, Lord, when bodhisattva great beings practicing
quotes.why: wrong speaker: the sutra line is addressed to the Lord (vocative), T1 makes the Blessed One its speaker

quotes.candidate: Regarding this, the Blessed One said: In this way, form is without any grasping.
quotes.reference: it says, It is because, Lord, form is not fully grasped
quotes.why: wrong speaker again: vocative 'Lord' turned into the Blessed One speaking

quotes.candidate: After thus showing the practice of not abiding, the Blessed One taught the following
quotes.reference: it says, “Furthermore, Lord, when bodhisattva great beings…
quotes.why: wrong speaker: the Lord is addressed (vocative), not the speaker

quotes.candidate: Then, the Elder Subhuti addressed the Blessed One, saying "This Prajnaparamita..."
quotes.reference: The elder Pūrṇa ... says: "Lord, tasked with the perfection of wisdom… this elder Subhūti thinks
quotes.why: makes Subhūti the speaker; the line is Pūrṇa's words about Subhūti

quotes.candidate: Then, the Elder Subhuti addressed the Blessed One, saying "This Prajnaparamita..."
quotes.reference: The elder Pūrṇa ... says: “Lord, ... this elder Subhūti thinks
quotes.why: wrong speaker: the words are addressed by Pūrṇa about Subhūti, not spoken by Subhūti

quotes.candidate: In the past, when I, the Blessed One, was a bodhisattva, the great śrāvakas ... taught me correctly
quotes.reference: earlier when our Lord was in the form of a bodhisattva, the great śrāvakas ... taught him
quotes.why: wrong speaker: a śrāvaka speaks of 'my/our Lord'; T2 makes the Blessed One the speaker and the one taught

quotes.candidate: In the past, when I, the Blessed One, was a bodhisattva ... I shall acknowledge what the śrāvakas of the past did for me.
quotes.reference: earlier when our Lord was in the form of a bodhisattva
quotes.why: wrong speaker: a śrāvaka speaks of 'our Lord'; T2 makes the Buddha the speaker

quotes.candidate: a second type of retrogression pertaining to the eighth stage is also taught
quotes.reference: it also teaches a second not turning back from progress toward full awakening that happens at the eighth level
quotes.why: the concessive 'although one becomes irreversible at the first level' requires a second irreversibility at the eighth; T2 turns it into retrogression

quotes.candidate: a second type of retrogression pertaining to the eighth stage is also taught
quotes.reference: it also teaches a second not turning back from progress toward full awakening that happens at the eighth level
quotes.why: after 'one becomes non-retrogressive at the first level, but...', the second kind is irreversibility; T2 makes it retrogression
